items.text: Levi anzipi: Gerisoni pi, Kohati pi, Merari pie.
Kohati anzi­pi: Amiramu pi, Izihari pi, Hebironi pi, Uzieli pie.
Efu 6:23
Lev 10:1
Amiramu anzipi: Aroni pi, Musa pi, Miriamu pie. Aroni anzipi: Nadabu pi, Abihu pi, Eleazari pi, Itamari pie.
Eleazari ti Finehasini, Finehasi ti Abisuani,
Abisua ti Bukini, Buki ti Uzini,
Uzi ti Zerahiani, Zerahia ti Merayotini,
Merayoti ti Amaria­ni, Amaria ti Ahitubuni,
Ahitu­bu ti Zadokini, Zadoki ti Ahimaazini,
Ahimaazi ti Azariani, Azaria ti Yohananini,
1 Opi 6:1
2 Sur 3:1
Yohanani ti Aza­riani (eri ’ba atalau edeta edepiri ma azi ngapi jo Sulemanini sile Yerusa­lemuariari’i).
Ezr 7:3
Azaria ti Ama­riani, Amaria ti Ahitubuni,
Ahi­tubu ti Zadokini, Zadoki ti Salumu­ni,
Salumu ti Hilikiani, Hilikia ti Azariani,
Azaria ti Serayani, Seraya ti Yehozadakini;
ji Ye­hozadakini ati’boru ewu Yehovani ’ba Yudaa ’diyi jizu ati’baru ’ba Yerusalemua ’diyi be, Nebukadineza ma driarisi,
Efu 6:16
Levi anzipi: Gerisoni pi, Ko­hati pi, Merari pie.
Gerisoni anzipi ma ru yi ’di: Libini pi Simei be.
Kohati anzipi yi ndra Ami­ramu pi, Izihari pi, Hebironi pi, Uzieli pie.
Kal 3:33
Merari anzipi: Mali pi Musi be. Te ’ba ’diyi ovu ori’ba ’ba Levini yi ma a’bipi vusi.
Gerisoni vile ’diyi: mvini Libi­ni’i, mvini Yahati’i, mvini Zima’i,
mvini Yoa’i, mvini do’i, mvini Zera’i, mvini Yeaterai’i,
Kohati anzipi: mvini Aminadabu’i, mvini Kora’i, mviru Asiri’i,
mini Elikana’i, mvini Ebiasafu’i, mvini Asiri’i,
mvini Tahati’i, mvini Urieli’i, mvini Uzia’i, mvini Saulo’i.
Elikana anzipi: Amasai pi Ahi­moti be.
Te Elikana ma e’yosi, anzi Elikanani ’diyi mvini Zofai’i, mvini Nahati’i,
mvini Eliabu’i, mvini Yerohamu’i, mvini Elikana’i.
Samueli anzipi mva okori Yoe­li’i, iriri Abiya’i.
Merari anzipi: Mali, mvini Libini’i, mvini Simei’i, mvini Uza’i,
mvini Simea’i, mvini Hagia’i, mvini Asaya’i.
1 Opi 8:4
Te ’ba Daudini ’bale azi ongo­niri ma dri cezu; Yehovania, sanduku Munguni ka nga pari ava lizuri isu ’boria ’diyi yi ’di.
Yi nga azi ongoniri bere hema ti ecizani­ri ma drilia, ecazu kpere Sulemanini jo Yehovani sizu Yerusalemua ’boria; yi te azi yini ma alia ’dani, yini yi awaleri vusi.
’Ba tepi azi yini ma alia ’dani ’diyi yi ’di, anzi yini be. Kohati anzipi ma eselia: Hemani ’ba ongo ngopiri Yoeli mvi, Samueli mvi,
Elikana mvi, Yerohamu mvi, Elieli mvi, Toa mvi,
Zufu mvi, Elikana mvi, Mahati mvi, Amasai mvi,
Elikana mvi, Yoeli mvi, Azaria mi, Zefania mvi,
Efu 6:24
Tahati mvi, Asiri mvi, Ebiasafu mvi, Kora mvi,
Izihari mvi, Kohati mvi, Levi mvi, Israeli mvi.
Azini adri Asafu, pa sopi eri ma dri ndiriari, eri Asafu Berekia mvi, Simea mvi,
Mikaeli mvi, Baa­seya mvi, Malikiya mvi,
Etini mvi, Zera mvi, Adaya mvi,
Eta­’ni mvi, Zima mvi, Simei mvi,
Yahati mvi, Gerisoni mi, Levi mvi.
Yi ma dri elialeruria yi adripi Merari ma anzipiyi: Etani Kisi mvi, Abidi mvi, Maluki mvi,
Hasa­bia mvi, Amazia mvi, Hilikia mvi,
Amizi mvi, Bani mvi, Semeri mvi,
Mali mvi, Musi mvi, Merari mvi, Levi mvi.
Ope adripi yini ’ba Levini ’diyi azi dria hema jo Munguniarini ngazu.
Lev 1:9
Kal 3:10
Ebra 5:1
Efu 30:7
Luk 1:9

Te Aroni pi anzipi be yi ede edeta pari edeta vezaru edezuri ma dria, azini pari obiese vele veri ede­zuri ma dria, azi dria pari alatararu turini ma e’yosi, azini azi onzi ’ba Israelini ma e’yo edezu ekile azita dria Musa ati’bo Mungunini ndra azilerile.
Efu 6:23
Lev 10:1
Kal 3:2
Aroni anzipi yi ’di: mvini Eleazari’i, mvini Finehasi’i, mvini Abisua’i.
mvini Buki’i, mvini Uzi’i, mvini Zerahia’i,
mvini Merayoti’i, mvini Amaria’i, mvini Ahitubu’i,
mvini Zado­ki’i, mvini Ahimaazi’i.
Te pari yini ovuzu, yini hema asolerile, angu yini ma esele vusi ’diyi yi ’di: Aroni anzipi ori’ba Kohatini ’diyi dri, odrisini fele yi ma runi e’dale okorisi, yi fe ’dini:
yi fe yi dri Hebironini Yuda ma angua, angu ageinia ’diyi be dria;
te amvu aku amboru ndeni, aku nyiri erini ’diyi be, fe yi Kalebu Yefune mvi dri.
Aroni anzipi dri yi fe aku ambo ambo ’bani apazu yi ma alia ’diyi: Hebironi pi, Libina pi angu ageiniari be indi, Yatiri pi, Esitemoa pi angu ageiniari be,
Hileni pi angu ageiniari be, Debiri pi angu ageiniari be,
Asani pi angu agemiani be, Beti-semesi pi angu ageiniari be;
azini suru Benyaminini ma eselia yi ’di: Geba pi angu ageiniari be, Alemeti pi angu ageiniari be, Anatoti pie angu ageiniari be. Aku ambo ambo dria ori’ba yini vusi ’diyi mudri drini na.
Yos 21:5
Kohati anzipi acepi ’diyi drii yi fe odrisi ’bezasi aku ambo ambo, mudri, engazu ori’ba suruni ma eselia, suru ma egalepi ma eselia, adani Manaseni ma egalepi’i.
Yi fe Gerisoni anzipi dri ori’ba yini vusi, aku ambo ambo mudri drini na suru Isakari pini ma eselia Aseri pie, Nafutali pie, Manase ovupi Basaniari pie dria.
Yos 21:7
Merari anzipi dri yi fe odrisi ’bezasi ori’ba yini vusi, aku ambo ambo mudri drini iri, engazu suru Rubeni pini ma eselia, Gadi pie, Zebuluni pie.
Anzi Israelini ’divi fe ’ba Levini dri aku ambo ambo’ angu ageiniari beni,
Yi fe odrisi ’bezasi suru Yuda anzipi pini ma eselia, Simeoni anzipi pie, Benyamini anzipi pie­dria, aku ambo ambo e’dale rusi ’diyi.
Ori’ba anzi Kohatini ma azi ’diyi ovu aku ambo ambo ovupi yi ma angua engazu suru Efiraimuni ma eselia ’diyi be.
Yi fe yi dri laku amboru ’bani apazu alenia ’diyi: Sekemu angu oniru Efiraimuniri pi angu ageiniari be, Gezeri pi angu ageiniari be indi,
Yokirneamu pi angu ageiniari be, Beti-horoni pi angu ageiniari be,
Aiyaloni pi angu ageiniari be, Gatirimoni pi angu ageiniari be dria;
te suru ali Manaseni ma eselia: Aneri pi angu ageiniari be, Bileamu pi angu lageiniari be, ori’ba anzi Kohatini acepi ’diyi ma joloko dri.
Azi 1:4
Fe anzi Gerisonini dri engazu ori’ba suru ali Manaseni ma eselia: Golani Basaniari pi angu ageiniari be, Asitaroti pi angu ageiniari be;
te engazu suru Isakarini ma eselia fe Kedesi pi angu ageiniari be, Daberati pi angu ageiniari be,
Ramoti pi angu ageiniari be, Anemu pi angu ageiniari be;
te engazu suru Aserini ma eselia fe Masali pi angu ageiniari be, Abidoni pi angu ageiniari be,
Hukoki pi angu ageiniari be, Rehobu pi angu ageiniari be;
te suru Nafutalini ma eselia: Kedesi Galiliari pi angu agemiani be, Hamoni pi angu ageiniari be, Kiriataimu pi angu ageiniari be.
Fe ’ba Levini acepi jolokoru anzi Merarini ’diyi dri engazu suru Zebulunini ma eselia: Rimono pi angu ageiniari be, Tabori pi angu ageiniari be,
azini Yoridania ’aa’dasi Yerikoa, Yoridani ma kala etuni efurialeruria, engazu suru Rubenini ma eselia, fe yi dri Bezeri angu roko driari pi angu ageiniari be, Yaza pi angu ageiniari be,
Kedemoti pi angu ageiniari be, Mefaati pi angu ageiniari be;
te engazu suru Gadini ma eselia fe Ramoti Gileadiari pi angu agei­nari be, Mahanaimu pi angu ageiniari be,
Azi 2:24
Isa 15:4
Hesiboni pi angu ageiniari be, Yazeri pi angu ageiniari pie dria.
